why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the YeNo homepage Go to yeno.pro and read the Points (PTS) section of the FAQ to see which activities earn points.

2 Step 2 : Press the Join YeNo button The Join YeNo button on the homepage opens a Telegram link. The homepage does not spell out where registration or swiping takes place, so follow what that link shows.
3 Step 3 : Swipe on predictions Pick Yes or No on prediction events with a swipe. The FAQ says each swipe earns PTS and also helps train YenoClaw.

4 Step 4 : Complete tasks and stay active Finish the tasks offered to you and keep using the platform, since the FAQ lists tasks and ongoing activity as ways to earn PTS. Buying a Boost in YeNo Prop also earns PTS, but Boosts are paid plans priced from $20.

5 Step 5 : Invite friends Inviting friends is another listed way to earn PTS, though the homepage does not say how those invitations are sent. Its affiliate program section says partners sign up to get a unique referral link. Questions can go to the support contact at t.me/alex_yeno .
